name: jira-hub
title: Jira Hub
description: Unified Jira dashboard with action-priority sections, overbook/reply/stale detection, and a live menu bar status
author: kahl.dev

commands.name: dashboard
commands.title: Jira Dashboard
commands.description: Unified view of all your Jira issues, prioritized by what needs action

commands.name: menubar
commands.title: Jira Status
commands.description: Live ticket counts in the macOS menu bar

preferences.name: instanceUrl
preferences.title: Jira Instance URL
preferences.description: Base URL of your Atlassian Cloud instance (no trailing slash)

preferences.name: internalProjectKeys
preferences.title: Internal Project Keys
preferences.description: Comma-separated project keys NOT counted as customer (e.g. internal/dev projects)

preferences.name: devProjectKeys
preferences.title: Backlog/Dev Project Keys (dimmed, excluded from Needs-Action)
preferences.description: Comma-separated project keys for low-priority backlog projects. Tickets here are dimmed at the bottom and never bubble into Needs-Action, even if stale or overbooked.

preferences.name: internalCoreProjectKeys
preferences.title: Internal Core Project Keys
preferences.description: Comma-separated project keys in the 'Intern' section (e.g. LIA,LIAKI,LIAC)

preferences.name: overbookThresholdPct
preferences.title: Overbook Threshold (%)
preferences.description: Ticket flagged as overbooked when spent/estimate >= this percentage

preferences.name: replyThresholdWorkdays
preferences.title: Reply-Needed Threshold (workdays)
preferences.description: Ticket flagged when last comment is from someone else and older than N workdays

preferences.name: staleThresholdWorkdays
preferences.title: Stale Threshold (workdays)
preferences.description: In-Progress ticket flagged when no update for N workdays
